name: Booster landing: train
summary: A Falcon 9-class booster learns to land on a drone ship by reinforcement learning (PPO), thousands of boosters at once on the GPU.
help: Run it on the machine with the NVIDIA GPU (Accelerator: NVIDIA GPU). Each attempt flies a booster with real physics (gravity, standard atmosphere, drag and lift of body and grid fins, one engine throttling 40-100% that lights once, gimbal, nitrogen thrusters, wind with a jet stream and gusts, a deck that heaves and rolls) and the policy decides 10 times a second: throttle, when to light the landing burn, and which way to lean. Six lessons: two starting mid-burn near the deck, then falling from 2.5-5, 5-12, 12-22 km and from the real hand-over after the entry burn (about 33 km, 1.3 km/s); a lesson opens when half the attempts of the one before land. Landed means on the deck under 2.5 m/s down, 1.5 m/s sideways, 8 degrees of lean. Telemetry: channel train (lesson, landed %, landed_full % from the hand-over, miss_m, touchdown_mps, attempts, steps_per_s, minutes, outcomes.*), channel rocket (one attempt replayed in the 3D view every Replay every seconds, esasim.rocket/1) and event (new lessons). The policy (booster_policy.pt) is saved every 2 minutes and kept at its best on full flights; the button Finish now (control channel) or the time limit ends the run with it. Wire an earlier booster_policy.pt to Continue from to pick up where it stopped. Booster mission flies it.

inputs.label: Continue from
inputs.help: A booster_policy.pt from an earlier run, to keep training it

outputs.label: Policy
outputs.help: booster_policy.pt: the landing policy (network, input scaling, lesson reached, landing rate)

outputs.label: Learning curve
outputs.help: training.csv: minutes, lesson, landing rates, miss, touchdown speed, steps per second

params.label: Accelerator
params.help: auto takes the NVIDIA GPU when this PyTorch can use it

params.label: Boosters at once
params.help: Parallel attempts on the GPU (the CPU uses at most 1024)

params.label: Stop at landing rate
params.help: Share of full flights (from the hand-over) that land, to stop early

params.label: Replay every (s)
params.help: How often one attempt is sent to the 3D view
